function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetFinalInterval(base)
    local s = GetPlayerStats(self.owner)

    if not base or base <= 0 then
        return 0.05
    end

    local pct = 1 + BpToFlat(s.ProjectileCooldown or 0)

    local final = base / pct

    if final < 0.05 then
        final = 0.05
    end

    --print("final interval", base, pct, final)

    return final
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetFinalCastRange(base)
    local s = GetPlayerStats(self.owner)
    local range = base or 0
    local final = range + (s.ProjectileRange or 0)

    return final
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:FirePseudoTrackingProjectile(profile, target)
    if not target or target:IsNull() then return end
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then return end
    if not self.ability or self.ability:IsNull() then return end

    -- Keep dummy on the hero.
    self.parent:SetAbsOrigin(self.owner:GetAbsOrigin())
    self.parent:FaceTowards(target:GetAbsOrigin())

    local proj_speed = 900

    local info = {
        Target     = target,
        Source     = self.owner,
        Ability    = self.ability,
        EffectName = self.ability:GetAbilityKeyValues().ProjectileModel,
        iMoveSpeed = proj_speed,
        bDodgeable = true,
        bIsAttack  = false,
        ExtraData  = {
            owner_entindex = self.owner:entindex(),
            dummy_entindex = self.parent:entindex(),
            base_damage    = profile.base_damage,
            hit_label      = profile.hit_label,
            proj_speed     = proj_speed,

            spawn_time     = GameRules:GetGameTime(),

        }
    }

    local proj_id = ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile(info)
    info.ExtraData.projectile_id = proj_id
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:InitProjectileProfile(params)
    if not params then return end
    local name = params.name
    if not name or name == "" or name == "none" then return end
    if not params.interval or params.interval <= 0 then return end

    local is_attack = (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack")
    local profile = {
        projectile_name = name,
        interval = params.interval,
        range = params.range or 0,
        base_damage = params.base_damage or 0,
        pure_percent = params.pure_percent or 0,
        lifesteal = params.lifesteal or 0,
        hit_label = hit_label,
        is_attack = is_attack,
        attack_mode = (name == "ranged_attack" and "ranged" or "melee"),
    }

    if not profile.is_attack then
        profile.skill = self.parent:AddAbility(name)
        if profile.skill then
            profile.skill:SetLevel(1)
            profile.skill:SetActivated(true)
            profile.skill_kv = profile.skill:GetAbilityKeyValues()
            profile.behavior = ResolveCastBehavior(profile.skill_kv)
        end
    else
        profile.behavior = "Target"
    end

    table.insert(self.projectiles, profile)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:StartProjectileTimers()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not self.projectiles or #self.projectiles == 0 then return end

    self.timer_handles = self.timer_handles or {}

    for idx, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        local base_interval = self:GetFinalInterval(profile.interval)
        local offset = math.min((idx - 1) * 0.1, base_interval * 0.5)
        local id = Timers:CreateTimer(offset, function()
            return self:OnProjectileThink(profile)
        end)
        table.insert(self.timer_handles, id)
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnProjectileThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    if self.is_paused then
        return 0.1
    end

    if not profile then
        return 0.1
    end

    if (not profile.is_attack and not profile.skill) or (not self.owner) or (self.owner:IsNull()) then
        return 0.1
    end

    local interval = self:GetFinalInterval(profile.interval)

    if profile.behavior == "Self" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })

        return interval
    end

    local origin = self.owner:GetAbsOrigin()
    local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(profile.range)

    local enemy = nil
    local pos = nil

    if profile.behavior == "Position" or profile.behavior == "Target" or profile.is_attack then
        local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
            self.owner:GetTeamNumber(),
            origin,
            nil,
            range,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
            FIND_CLOSEST,
            false
        )

        if #enemies == 0 then
            return interval
        end

        enemy = enemies[1]
        pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()

        local dir = pos - origin
        dir.z = 0
        local minDist = range * 0.5
        local maxDist = range - 50
        local normal_dir = dir:Normalized()

        local dist = dir:Length2D()
        if dist < 150 then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * minDist
        end

        if dist > range then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * maxDist
        end
    end

    if profile.is_attack then
        self.parent.__autocast_attack_profile = profile
        if profile.attack_mode == "ranged" then
            self:FirePseudoTrackingProjectile(profile, enemy)
        else
            self.parent:PerformAttack(
                enemy,
                true,  -- bUseCastAttackOrb
                true,  -- bProcessProcs
                true,  -- bSkipCooldown
                false, -- bIgnoreInvis
                false, -- bUseProjectile
                false, -- bFakeAttack
                true   -- bNeverMiss
            )
        end
        return interval
    end

    if pos then
        self.parent:SetCursorPosition(pos)
        self.parent:FaceTowards(pos)
    end

    if profile.behavior == "Position" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
            Position = pos,
            Queue = false,
        })
    elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    elseif profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    end

    return interval
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name)
    if not self.projectiles then return nil end

    if not ability_name then
        for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
            if profile.is_attack then
                return profile
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if profile.projectile_name == ability_name then
            return profile
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function ResolveCastBehavior(ability_kv)
    local behavior = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""
    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT") then
        return "Position"
    end

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET") then
        local target_team = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityUnitTargetTeam or ""
        if HasBehavior(target_team, "DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_FRIENDLY") then

        end
        return "Target"
    end

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") then

    end

    return "NoTarget"
end

- 在 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_item_autocast_controller.lua` 读取上述新 KV 字段并传给 `modifier_dummy_autocast`。  
- 在 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_dummy_autocast.lua`：

- “特殊处理”只通过 KV 体现，不需要为每个技能写专门脚本。  
- 临时 dummy 生命周期绑定到 item（`modifier_dummy_autocast` 销毁时清理）。  
- PassiveSP/普通攻击是否继承由配置控制，避免无限递归或性能炸裂。
